clause_text: The employee agrees to unlimited overtime without additional compensation.
Either party may terminate this agreement with 30 days written notice.
The company shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.
This agreement shall be governed by the laws of India.
The contractor shall indemnify and hold harmless the company from all claims.
Payment shall be made within 30 days of invoice receipt.
The employee waives all rights to sue the employer for any reason.
Confidential information shall not be disclosed to third parties.
The company reserves the right to change terms at any time without notice.
This contract is effective as of the date of signing.
The employee agrees to a non-compete clause for 5 years after termination.
The parties agree to resolve disputes through arbitration.
The contractor shall complete work within the agreed timeline.
All intellectual property created shall belong to the company.
The company provides health insurance benefits to full-time employees.
Late payments shall incur interest at 2% per month.
The employee is entitled to 15 days of paid leave per year.
The company may terminate employment without cause or notice.
Confidentiality obligations survive termination of this agreement.
The contractor warrants that work will be free from defects.
